_note: SYNTHETIC. Invented places with invented Google Place IDs, shaped like wf_inventory rows plus a joined `editorial`. Exists so matching and shadow ranking can be exercised without a database or a live Places call. refreshed_at is a placeholder the tests overwrite with a relative date so freshness never silently expires the fixture.
